# plakous-codex-code-mode-protocol

A reviewed vendor snapshot of the Codex Code Mode description and schema
rendering from the OpenAI Codex repository, published under a Plakous name so
that `plakous-code-mode` builds from the registry without a `[patch]` table.
Upstream publishes it as `codex-code-mode-protocol`; this copy keeps the
upstream version number, the Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` and the upstream `NOTICE`,
and `PROVENANCE.md` records the exact upstream revision and the files copied.
It is part of [Plak](https://github.com/N0xMare/plak) and carries no support
promise of its own.
